cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

mechanism: A sets the terms of each fantastic offer from a position of assumed precedence, demanding a more committed impossible service and justifying it for the occasion.
confusable: Generic lavish taste is confusable: B must actually offer something strange and A must enlarge that offer for a stated reason while deciding its acceptability.
comparison: Restaurant procurement lets A direct a supplier; wedding hospitality lets A direct an invited friend and accommodate wandering relatives.
seedUse: All four canonical seeds read: flying restaurant service and wandering wedding guests supply the escalating offers; replace removable Stance prefaces with actual conditions on accepting them.
